reported.title: Serial output uses wrong prefix and never matches Temp: format
reported.description: printTemp on line 34 prints "temp=" instead of the required "Temp: " prefix, so no line ever matches the expected pattern. The measured evidence confirms this: no serial line matched /^Temp: -?[0-9]+\.[0-9]$/ in 8.00 s across all scenarios. No serial line matched /^Temp: -?[0-9]+\.[0-9]$/ in 8.00 s; expected one every 1000 ms.

reported.title: Printed temperature cannot be parsed due to wrong label
reported.description: Because line 34 emits "temp=" rather than "Temp: ", the value regex /Temp: (-?[0-9.]+)/ never matches, so the printed value can never be compared to A0. Measured evidence: "No serial line matched /Temp: (-?[0-9.]+)/ so the printed value could not be compared with A0" in every scenario. No serial line matched /Temp: (-?[0-9.]+)/ so the printed value could not be compared with A0.

reported.title: Range lamp chatters at the 50 °C boundary with no hysteresis
reported.description: updateRangeLamp on line 28 compares the raw noisy reading against HIGH_C with no hysteresis or filtering, so noise near 50 °C toggles D7 rapidly. Measured evidence: D7 was in the wrong state for 3564 ms across 1346 intervals in the threshold-hover scenario, first at 500 ms. D7 was in the wrong state for 3418 ms across 1419 interval(s), first at 500 ms: D7 was not LOW for 4 ms while required (grace 500 ms).

reported.title: Range lamp chatters at the -10 °C boundary with no hysteresis
reported.description: The same line 28 comparison against LOW_C has no hysteresis, so noise straddling -10 °C flips D7 back and forth. Measured evidence: D7 was in the wrong state for 3418 ms across 1419 intervals in the -10 °C hover scenario, first at 500 ms. D7 was in the wrong state for 2604 ms across 1067 interval(s), first at 500 ms: D7 was not LOW for 3 ms while required (grace 500 ms).

exposing_checks.behaviour: serial lines matching '^Temp: ' every 1000 ms (Temp: lines)
serial values for 'Temp: (-?[0-9.]+)' match the stimulus (tolerance 1.5) (Value OK)

judge_input.spec:
- TMP36 on A0 (10 mV/°C with 500 mV offset); freeze button on D5 (pull-up); range lamp on D7.
- Every 1000 ms print exactly `Temp: <celsius>` with a space after the colon and one decimal place.
- Printed temperature must stay within ±1.5 °C of the injected probe value.
- While D5 is held LOW, freeze the reported value at the last sample.
- Light D7 when the reported temperature is outside -10.0 to 50.0 °C.
- Also print `weather n=<samples>` each second after the Temp line.
